question: Change the metrics middleware to use a new MetricsCollector interface instead of directly using prometheus.Registerer. Any component that registers HTTP client metrics through this middleware must implement MetricsCollector.

answer.proposed_change: Define a MetricsCollector interface and replace prometheus.Registerer with MetricsCollector in the middleware constructor signatures

interface_definition.name: MetricsCollector
interface_definition.rationale: The MetricsMiddleware currently only calls promRegisterer.MustRegister() at line 69-75. The MetricsCollector interface needs exactly this one method. prometheus.Registerer already satisfies this interface, so existing callers passing prometheus.Registerer will continue to work without adaptation.

impact_analysis.reason: The new MetricsCollector interface requires only MustRegister(...prometheus.Collector), which prometheus.Registerer already implements. This means prometheus.Registerer implicitly satisfies MetricsCollector, so all existing callers compile without changes. However, callers should be updated to explicitly pass a MetricsCollector for clarity.

Auto-generated by Wire. Will be regenerated when wire is re-run after the signature changes in pluginsintegration.go. The wire injection currently provides prometheus.Registerer — since it satisfies MetricsCollector, no wire provider changes needed.

This is a separate HTTP client metrics middleware that also uses prometheus.Registerer via Register()/MustRegister()/WithMustRegister() methods on PrometheusMetrics. If the MetricsCollector interface is meant to be project-wide, this file's PrometheusMetrics struct could implement MetricsCollector by adding a MustRegister method that delegates to its existing metrics registration. Currently, this file creates metrics independently and registers them via its own Register/MustRegister pattern — it would need to be refactored to accept a MetricsCollector if the goal is universal abstraction.

Uses promauto (auto-registration with default registerer) for datasource request metrics. If MetricsCollector is to replace all direct prometheus.Registerer usage for HTTP client metrics, these global promauto.New* calls would need to be refactored to use a MetricsCollector passed at construction time instead of relying on the global default registerer.

design_considerations.interface_satisfaction: prometheus.Registerer already has MustRegister(...prometheus.Collector), so it implicitly implements MetricsCollector. This means the refactoring is backward-compatible — existing code passing prometheus.Registerer will compile without changes.
design_considerations.testability_improvement: The MetricsCollector interface enables easy mocking in tests. Test code can provide a no-op or recording MetricsCollector without needing a real Prometheus registry.
design_considerations.scope_decision: The question targets 'the metrics middleware' (singular) — this is pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/metrics_middleware.go. The HTTP client middlewares in httpclientprovider/ are separate middlewares that could optionally adopt MetricsCollector for consistency but are not the primary target.
design_considerations.alternative_approach: Instead of defining MetricsCollector in the clientmiddleware package, it could be defined in a shared metrics package (e.g., pkg/infra/metrics/) so that both the plugin metrics middleware and the HTTP client metrics middlewares can use the same interface.

impact_analysis.recommendation: This is a sound abstraction. Define MetricsCollector in metrics_middleware.go with a single MustRegister method, update the constructor signatures, and update the wiring in pluginsintegration.go. Since prometheus.Registerer already satisfies this interface, the change is non-breaking. For broader adoption, consider placing the interface in a shared package and updating the httpclientprovider middlewares to use it as well.
